sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines equipment inspection I2, which must be preformed every 
3000 working hours as indicated by H3000 in the title block. (3000HS, 
1EA-P001A)

The pump 
supplier KSB Germany type SNW 600-719

The motor type: ANVE-WT001, supplier: 
Teco electric & machinery Co., LTD Taiwan,

The first draft initiated by eng. Hany Samoiel Ibragem, reviewed by eng. 
 Hamza Helmy El-Sayed Alshafie, tested by eng. Mohamed Alkhateb Mohamed 
 Salem, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Mohamed Hassan Zayed, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 Engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution works surrounding the work area is required
ارتداء معدات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة السلامة وأحذية السلامة ... الخ
Isolate the pump mechanically and the motor electrically

Be sure the motor of the pump is stopped and its breaker isolated before 
 starting any maintenance.

Electrical Isolation:
- Circuit breaker 1NB011 is opened
 - Switch off the DC Supply
 - Space heater 9NHA 31A- ICH-26 is open

Mechanical Isolation:
- Close the discharge valve 1EA-V001A

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check the rubber (8 pieces, no. 315 coupling & alignment coupling (Air 
gap:3-8mm, radial:0.468, axial:;0.468)

Check the oil (viscosity, acid no., contamination) for thrust 
bearings (pump and motor) and change if required

Ensure the grease Mobile plex 47 for lower bearing of motor 
and change if required.
Check the tighten for all bolts of the pump and motor.

Clean the cooling water pipes of thrust bearing (pump and 
motor)
Check all valves (drains, vent, ... etc)
Generally clean the external pump body

Check the packing ( 4 pieces, 95x127x16mm, RT-P) and shaft 
 protecting sleeve and change if required.
